issues.description: Field Farm.animals: the Problem Statement and UML require the farm to store animals in a List<Animal> and explicitly instruct to initialize an ArrayList in the no-arg constructor (problem_statement.md). The solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) declares the field as Set<Animal> and initializes it with a HashSet. This mismatch (List/ArrayList vs Set/HashSet) changes semantics (ordering, duplicate handling) and will confuse students about the expected collection type and behavior and can cause tests or instructor expectations to diverge from the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's Farm match the Problem Statement: change the field declaration to List<Animal> and initialize it with new ArrayList<>() in the no-arg constructor; update the getter/setter signatures to use List<Animal>. Alternatively, if the intended design is to allow a Set, update the UML and problem text to state Set/HashSet explicitly so all artifacts are consistent. Ensure tests and examples reflect the chosen collection semantics.
